stage_2_story.text_en: This year, the family decided to throw a surprise party for grandfather's seventieth birthday. His daughter sent invitations to more than thirty relatives. The children helped hang colourful decorations around the living room, and someone ordered a large chocolate cake with seventy candles. When grandfather walked through the door, everyone shouted 'Surprise!' He laughed and nearly dropped his hat. He opened gift after gift — books, warm clothes, a photo album full of family memories. When it was time for the cake, grandfather made a wish, took a deep breath, and blew out every candle. Everyone clapped and cheered. It was the best birthday celebration the family had ever had, and grandfather said it was the happiest day of his year.
